events.title: OpenAI Sora consumer app shut down
events.summary: OpenAI discontinued the Sora consumer app on April 26, 2026 — ending the social video product launched with Sora 2 in September 2025.
events.about: Seven months after Sora 2's TikTok-style launch, OpenAI pulled the standalone app while keeping [API] access for a transition period. The shutdown marked a retreat from consumer social video toward enterprise and [API] video generation — a rare reversal after a high-profile consumer AI bet.

narrative.whyChosen: Sora's shutdown closed one of the shortest-lived major consumer AI product experiments.
narrative.whyImportant: It showed even frontier labs could not sustain social video apps against compute costs and moderation risk.
narrative.problemSolved: OpenAI refocused video generation on [API] and partner integrations rather than a standalone feed.
